owner_pause.reason: Owner-directed pause of scheduled commercial/librarian automation while infrastructure and slot consolidation are in progress.

plan_a.name: hourly continuous execution window
plan_a.purpose: Remain work-conserving for a bounded near-hourly window; each runner tick processes all pending adapter work, not one arbitrary item.

plan_b.name: supported-interval recovery tick
plan_b.purpose: When the last accepted Plan A window is stale or absent, execute one bounded existing-runner tick on the next watchdog interval.

roi_registry_integrity_verified.evidence: Registry v1.3 and FORKS-ROI mandate independently read back; mandate SHA-256 and registry root validated.

carbon_partner_routes_verified.evidence: Public partner, website-service, and Quick Technical Review routes returned content from the deployed merge commit.

rules.automatic_return_to_plan_a: The next successful Plan A window writes a fresh accepted timestamp and changes PLAN_B back to PLAN_A.
rules.fallback_scope: Existing overdrive runner only; it does not claim that the three LLM worker automations have been awakened.
